en.bdb: See yourself as lover of the holy congregation ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਲਖ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਿ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh brahame lakh vedh paR net net kar kar sabh thake|

en.bdb: Millions of Brahmas, reciting millions of Vedas got tired saying nett nett )(this is not, this is not).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਲਖ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਣੀਦੈ ਅਕੇ।
verses.translit_en: mahaadhev avadhoot lakh jog dhiaan uneedhai ake|

en.bdb: Mahadev and millions of recluses are also fed up with sleeplessness of yogic practice.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਲੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਫੜਿ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh bisan avataar lai giaan khaRag faR pahuch na sake|

en.bdb: Becoming millions of incarnations, Visnu even catching hold of the double edged sword of knowledge could not reach Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲੋਮਸੁ ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵਣੇ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਧਕੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lomas chir jeevane aadh a(n)t vich dheerak dhake|

en.bdb: Millions of long lived rishi such as Lomas despite their fortitude are, ultimately jostled about.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰ ਢਕੇ।
verses.translit_en: tin loa jug chaar kar lakh brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd kar ddake|

en.bdb: That Lord has covered with His 'self, all the three worlds, four ages, millions of universes and their divisions, i.e.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਪਰਲਉ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਲਖ ਹਰਹਟ ਮਾਲਾ ਅਖਿ ਫਰਕੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh paralau utapat lakh harahaT maalaa akh farake|

en.bdb: He is bigger than these all. Millions of creations and dissolutions go on moving like the chain of pots on persian wheel and all this is enacted  within the time of the fall of an eyelid.
If someone becomes lover of the ,holy congregation, only then he can understand this mystery
